thumbAlt.zh: 賽博蛇遊戲畫面：霓虹蛇喺發光網格上追住能量球
thumbAlt.en: CYBER SNAKE gameplay: a neon snake chasing an energy orb across a glowing grid

howto.zh:
• 滑動或方向鍵轉向；唔可以 180° 掉頭
• 食數據核長大，快速連食有連擊
• Shift／B／衝刺掣：短爆發加速（有冷卻）
• 食夠本關目標就升級；之後係無盡，背景主題會換
• H 開關食物方向提示；P／Esc 暫停
howto.en:
• Swipe or arrow keys to turn (no 180° reverse)
• Eat data cores to grow; quick chains score combos
• Shift / B / BOOST for a short dash (cooldown)
• Hit the level target to rank up; then endless with theme swaps
• H toggles food-direction hint; P / Esc pauses

thumbAlt.zh: 數據熔合遊戲畫面：霓虹 4×4 棋盤上合併發光數字方塊
thumbAlt.en: DATA FUSE gameplay: glowing number blocks merging on a neon 4×4 board

howto.zh:
• 任意位置滑動（或方向鍵／WASD）推晒所有方塊
• 相同數字相撞就熔合成雙倍
• 慢慢諗，冇時間限制；卡住可用復原
• 長按滑動／脈衝掣／X：脈衝熔合相鄰同號
• 熔出高倍數會換區域，永遠有下一個目標
howto.en:
• Swipe anywhere (or arrows / WASD) to slide every cube
• Equal numbers merge into double
• No timer — think calmly; use Undo when stuck
• Hold swipe / pulse / X for adjacent-only pulse merge
• High merges open new zones; there is always a next goal

genre.zh: 邪惡電子寵物 · 短局照料 · 長期腐化
genre.en: Evil cyber Tamagotchi · short care · long corruption

thumbAlt.zh: 腐核寵遊戲畫面：Q版罪晶蛋站喺遠景霓虹城市夜空前
thumbAlt.en: CORRUPT.PET: a Q-version sin-chip egg against a far neon cityscape

stage.zh: 網頁 MVP v0.1.4：軟填色＋霓虹描邊光暈＋更深遠景層 · 已加 privacy.html · 待 Roy 肉眼
stage.en: web MVP v0.1.4: soft fill + neon rim glow + deeper cityscape · privacy.html added · awaiting Roy eye-check

games.kit: procedural Canvas2D (no full cyber-kit HUD yet)

howto.zh:
• 撳罪晶蛋孵化，之後用行動養一隻邪惡電子寵
• 留意五條錶：飢餓、穩定、過熱、忠誠、故障
• 餵食／忽視／注入／接駁／懲罰會推高唔同路線
• 忠誠穩 → 企業工蜂；故障餓 → 街頭病毒
• 離線都會慢慢變化；熔掉可以再孵
howto.en:
• Tap the sin-chip egg to hatch, then tend an evil cyber pet
• Watch five meters: hunger, stability, heat, loyalty, glitch
• Feed / Neglect / Inject / Jack-in / Punish steer the fork
• Loyalty+stability → Corporate Drone; glitch+hunger → Street Virus
• It simmers offline; melt fail lets you re-hatch

thumbAlt.zh: 霓虹記憶遊戲畫面：霓虹卡牌翻開配對
thumbAlt.en: NEON RECALL gameplay: neon holo cards flipped to find matching pairs

howto.zh:
• 開關會短暫預覽全部卡，記住先再翻
• 撳兩張一樣就配對；連擊有加分
• 冇時間限制；失誤越少星星越多
• 透視可短暫睇晒牌；長按透視＝超載透視
• 後段關卡會有錯亂／修飾器，保持冷靜
howto.en:
• Each level previews every card briefly — memorise, then flip
• Match two identical cards; streaks boost score
• No timer; fewer misses mean more stars
• Peek shows all cards briefly; hold Peek for Overload Peek
• Later levels add scramble modifiers — stay calm

genre.zh: 包剪揼 · 過三關 · 神經反射

thumbAlt.zh: 賽博小遊戲合集遊戲畫面：霓虹擂台上嘅包剪揼對決
thumbAlt.en: CYBER MINI PACK gameplay: a rock-paper-scissors round on a neon arena

howto.zh:
• 一個 App 三個模式：包剪揼、過三關、神經反射
• 包剪揼：出招對 AI；小心假訊號，可長按下注
• 過三關：你係 ✕；打和都過關，後段有舞台修飾
• 神經反射：綠先撳、洋紅唔好撳；留意三跑道同按住鬆手
• 每個模式都有無盡挑戰
howto.en:
• Three modes in one app: RPS, Tic-Tac-Toe ladder, Reaction
• RPS: beat AI tells; watch Fake Tell; hold to wager
• Tic-Tac-Toe: you are X; draws clear stages; later stage mods
• Reaction: tap green, skip magenta; tri-lane + hold-release rounds
• Each mode has an endless climb

genre.zh: 單手 3D 天台酷跑（12 關 + 無盡模式）

thumbAlt.zh: 霓虹火柴人酷跑遊戲畫面：霓虹火柴人喺天台之間衝刺
thumbAlt.en: NEON STICK RUN gameplay: a neon stick runner dashing across rooftops

stage.zh: 網頁版 v1.0 完成 · 待 Roy 試玩 · 未包裝 Android
stage.en: web v1.0 done · awaiting Roy's review · not packaged for Android

rule.zh: 每日 3 局；只開放第 1–3 關，無盡模式跑到 800 米，之後彈解鎖提示返大廳（遊戲已實作 trial=1）
rule.en: 3 runs per day; stages 1–3 only and endless up to 800 m, then an unlock prompt back to the hub (implemented in-game via trial=1)

howto.zh:
• 角色自動向前跑，單手操作
• 撳／上掃＝跳（長按更高；半空再撳＝二段跳）
• 下掃＝滑鏟；右掃＝衝刺／飛踢可撞無人機
• 自動跨越矮箱；廣告牆可走壁；鈎點可擺盪
• 關卡攞星，或者跑無盡衝距離
howto.en:
• Auto-run forward; one-thumb controls
• Tap / swipe ↑ to jump (hold higher; mid-air = double jump)
• Swipe ↓ slide; swipe → dash / kick drones
• Auto-step low boxes; wall-run ads; swing on hooks
• Clear staged maps for stars, or go endless for distance

thumbAlt.zh: 異域凶間遊戲畫面：駕駛戰機飛越霓虹城市上空自動開火對抗敵人
thumbAlt.en: XENO NIGHTMARE gameplay: auto-firing over a neon city while enemies attack

rule.zh: 每日 3 局；日後 App 版每局玩到第 5 波（第一隻巨獸）為止
rule.en: 3 runs per day; app build will cap each run at wave 5 (first boss)

howto.zh:
• 任意位置拖動移動戰機；自動開火
• 打敵機儲能量，撳「裂空斬」清彈幕兼重創巨獸
• 拾取 P 火力、S 護盾、E 能量
• 每 5 波打星海魔獸；護盾歸零就失敗（可復活一次）
• 無盡波數一直有下一個挑戰
howto.en:
• Drag anywhere to fly your craft; auto-fire is always on
• Build energy, then Rift Slash to clear bullets and hurt bosses
• Pick up P power, S shield, E energy
• Boss every 5 waves; shield zero fails the run (one revive)
• Endless waves keep raising the next challenge

genre.zh: 四合一棋盤對戰（國際象棋 · 象棋 · 黑白棋 · 飛行棋）
genre.en: 4-in-1 board battles (chess · xiangqi · flip · sky race)

thumbAlt.zh: 賽博棋鬥遊戲畫面：霓虹立體國際象棋對局
thumbAlt.en: CYBER BOARD gameplay: a neon 3D chess match in progress

rule.zh: 每日 3 局；日後 App 版試玩只開放 AI 第 1–2 級同無盡塔第 1–3 層
rule.en: 3 runs per day; app build will limit trials to AI levels 1–2 and tower floors 1–3

howto.zh:
• 揀棋種：國際象棋、象棋、黑白棋、飛行棋
• 撳棋子再撳目標格（綠＝可走，紅＝可食）
• 飛行棋撳擲骰；對決動畫可撳跳過
• 單指拖相機旋轉，捏合縮放
• 每款棋都有無盡之塔同 AI 對手
howto.en:
• Pick Chess, Xiangqi, Flip, or Sky Race
• Tap a piece, then a legal square (green move / red capture)
• Sky Race uses the dice button; tap to skip capture cinema
• Drag to orbit the camera; pinch to zoom
• Each game has an Endless Tower vs stronger AI

genre.zh: 3D 霓虹塔防（8 張地圖 + 無盡模式）

thumbAlt.zh: 霓虹堡壘遊戲畫面：霓虹城市網格上嘅防禦塔攔截沿通道衝向核心嘅病毒
thumbAlt.en: NEON BASTION gameplay: towers on a neon city grid stopping viruses on the path to the core

stage.zh: 網頁版 v1.1 完成 · 待 Roy 試玩 · 未包裝 Android
stage.en: web v1.1 done · awaiting Roy's review · not packaged for Android

rule.zh: 每日 3 局；戰役只開放地圖 1–2，無盡模式玩到第 10 波，之後彈解鎖提示返大廳（遊戲已實作 trial=1）
rule.en: 3 runs per day; campaign maps 1–2 only and endless up to wave 10, then an unlock prompt back to the hub (implemented in-game via trial=1)

howto.zh:
• 病毒沿數據通道衝向核心，核心歸零就失守
• 點發光格起塔；再點塔升級或出售
• 五種塔：激光、冷凍、導彈、電弧、超頻節點
• 可 1×／2× 加速；提早召喚下一波有獎
• 戰役 8 圖攞星，或打無盡波數
howto.en:
• Viruses rush the core along data lanes — core HP zero loses
• Tap a lit pad to build; tap a tower to upgrade or sell
• Five towers: laser, freeze, missile, arc, overclock node
• Use 1×/2× speed; early-call the next wave for a bonus
• Campaign maps for stars, or endless waves

genre.zh: 3D 分類／堆疊混合休閒解謎

thumbAlt.zh: 霓虹歸位遊戲畫面：透明管柱入面分類發光彩球
thumbAlt.en: NEON SORT gameplay: sorting glowing orbs inside neon transparent tubes

stage.zh: 網頁版 v0.2 polish · 12 關 + 無盡 · 待 Roy 試玩 · 未包裝 Android
stage.en: web v0.2 polish · 12 stages + endless · awaiting Roy · not packaged for Android

rule.zh: 每日 3 局；只開放第 1–5 關，無盡模式分數閘門後彈解鎖提示（待完整實作）
rule.en: 3 runs per day; stages 1–5 only and endless until a score gate, then unlock prompt (full wiring pending)

howto.zh:
• 拖霓虹磚／彩球去正確管道堆疊歸位
• 合法落點會亮綠環；非法會閃震
• 清晒目標就過關；有悔棋同重開
• 12 關之後係無盡模式
• 手機請用較大觸控，慢慢堆
howto.en:
• Drag neon bricks / orbs into the right pipes to stack-clear
• Valid drops show a green ring; illegal moves flash
• Clear the board to win; Undo and Restart are available
• 12 stages, then endless
• Use larger hit targets on phone — stack patiently

genre.zh: 3D 逃亡射擊：實驗室飛碟脫離控制，軍隊一路追
genre.en: 3D run-and-gun: a lab UFO breaks out while the army hunts it

thumbAlt.zh: 失控飛碟遊戲畫面：青色圓碟飛碟喺實驗室禁區對抗軍隊
thumbAlt.en: ROGUE UFO gameplay: a cyan saucer fleeing the army in a lab lockdown

stage.zh: 網頁版：主角已改青色圓碟飛碟 · 畫面清晰度已提高 · 另外兩款飛碟未開放 · 未包裝 Android
stage.en: web: player is now a cyan saucer · sharper render · two other crafts not open yet · not packaged for Android

rule.zh: 每日 3 局；試玩約 8 分鐘／第一個精英里程碑後彈解鎖提示返大廳（待完整實作）
rule.en: 3 runs per day; trial ends around 8 min / first elite milestone, then unlock prompt (full wiring pending)

howto.zh:
• 你係一部脫離實驗室嘅飛碟
• 虛擬搖桿移動；武器自動打
• 拾取 X 經驗、H 修復、武器升級方塊
• 完成 HUD 合約擊殺目標攞分
• 存活越耐，來襲單位越多
howto.en:
• You are a lab UFO on the run
• Move with the virtual stick; guns fire on their own
• Pick up X XP, H repair, and weapon upgrade cubes
• Finish HUD contract kill goals for score
• Longer runs draw more hunters

genre.zh: 3D 機甲格鬥：機甲劍士／魔法師／拳師／刺客（十連戰 + 無盡塔）
genre.en: 3D mech fighter: Mech Sword / Mage / Brawler / Assassin (10-fight ladder + endless tower)

thumbAlt.zh: 機甲雷台遊戲畫面：炭黑青能機甲劍士喺霓虹大賽舞台近身對打
thumbAlt.en: MECH THUNDER ARENA gameplay: charcoal+cyan mech sword fighters dueling on a neon tournament stage

stage.zh: 獨立格鬥產品路線（2026-10-25 split）：網頁原型機甲劍士 bitmap + 動作測試 · 見 docs/PRODUCT-SPLIT.md · 未包裝 Android
stage.en: Standalone fighter track (2026-10-25 split): web prototype bitmap mech sword + Action Test · see docs/PRODUCT-SPLIT.md · not packaged for Android

rule.zh: 每日 3 局；四個職業都玩得，階梯模式只開放第 1–3 戰，無盡塔只開放第 1–3 層，之後彈解鎖提示返大廳（遊戲已實作 trial=1）
rule.en: 3 runs per day; all four classes, ladder fights 1–3 and endless floors 1–3 only, then an unlock prompt back to the hub (implemented in-game via trial=1)

games.productSplit: Standalone Google Play fighter (SF/KOF-style); NOT hub casual. See docs/PRODUCT-SPLIT.md + neon-stick-duel/docs/PRODUCT-SPLIT.md

howto.zh:
• 揀職業：劍士／魔法師／拳師／刺客
• 左搖桿走位；右掣攻擊連段、技能、跳、防禦
• 攻擊連撳出 3–4 下；儲滿能量放必殺
• 防禦＋方向＝閃避；空中可二段跳
• 階梯十戰或無盡塔往上打
howto.en:
• Pick Swordsman, Mage, Brawler, or Assassin
• Left stick moves; right cluster: attack string, skills, jump, guard
• Mash attack for 3–4 hits; fill the meter for Ult
• Guard + direction = dodge; double-jump in air
• Climb the 10-fight ladder or Endless Tower
